validity.recommendation: check Diameter 820 (two Ду-1020 strings per Rostov UMG) and StartYear1 1961 (second string 1965 per uk.wikipedia); LengthKnownKm 1177 unsourced
validity.researcher_notes: String II exists (Transgaz Moscow lists I and II нитка, Wayback 2024-11 and 2024-12). Rostov UMG history says both strings are Ду-1020, contradicting 820; uk.wikipedia dates the second Rostov-Serpukhov string to 1965, not 1961. Length 1177 is copied from P1470 and is not sourced per string. Not a duplicate of P1470.

fills.researcher_notes: String II: Transgaz Moscow lists it among магистральные газопроводы (natural gas transmission). Transgaz Moscow Voronezh LPUMG page (Wayback 2024-11-15; hand-read): lists '7 магистральных газопроводов ... МГ Краснодарский Край — Серпухов I нитка; МГ Краснодарский Край — Серпухов II нитка' in the Северный Кавказ — Центр corridor. Name confirmed by hand (verifier substring screen missed the dash/nbsp variant).

Pipeline name 'Краснодарский край-Серпухов' (Rostov UMG history) and uk.wikipedia 'від Ростова до ... Серпухова' place the ends in Krasnodar Krai and Serpukhov (Moscow Oblast). Endpoint names are name-derived; no document gives a coordinate. Rostov UMG history (ucit-rostov.narod.ru, Gazprom Rostov UMG 50-year history): '1957-1966 гг. ... две нитки Ду-1020мм газопровода «Краснодарский край-Серпухов»'; '1967-1976 ... Продолжилось строительство второй очереди газопровода «Краснодарский край-Серпухов»'. Verifier OK.

Both Transgaz Moscow LPUMG pages (Wayback 2024-11/12) show the string operated by Gazprom Transgaz Moscow, a wholly owned Gazprom PJSC subsidiary, inside the Gazprom site. No page states ownership in words, so this supports owner only by inference; low. Not independent (one origin).

'магистральный газопровод' (trunk main) in the Северный Кавказ — Центр corridor, operated by LPUMG of Transgaz Moscow; transmission confirmed. Transgaz Moscow Voronezh LPUMG page (Wayback 2024-11-15; hand-read): lists '7 магистральных газопроводов ... МГ Краснодарский Край — Серпухов I нитка; МГ Краснодарский Край — Серпухов II нитка' in the Северный Кавказ — Центр corridor. Name confirmed by hand (verifier substring screen missed the dash/nbsp variant).

Worklist value is the same for both strings (1177 km); no source found giving 1177 km for either string. Searched Transgaz Moscow LPUMG pages, ru/uk Wikipedia, Rostov UMG history, energybase (geo-blocked), zakupki360 (JS shell). uk.wikipedia gives 1773 km for the whole Krasnodar-Serpukhov system of pipes (both strings plus loops), not per string: 1177 may be a digit transposition of 1773 or a per-route figure; flagged in validity, value kept.

String II still listed as operated by Transgaz Moscow in Wayback captures of 2024-11-15 (Voronezh LPUMG) and 2024-12-12 (Elets LPUMG: 'Краснодарский край — Серпухов 1 и 2 нитка' under 'надежная эксплуатация'). Same operator origin; medium.

Recorded 820 mm. Rostov UMG history says BOTH Krasnodar-Serpukhov strings are Ду-1020; uk.wikipedia gives ~1000 mm; only an unverifiable tender-title snippet (zakupki360 JS shell, not cited) mentions Ду 820 for the 1st string section. No citable source states 820 for string II. Filed as spec concern.

Recorded 1961 is the first string per uk.wikipedia; it puts the second Rostov-Serpukhov string in 1965 (with 207 km of loops built 1964). Staged 1965 with the concern filed in validity; single secondary source (Wikipedia, footnoted to Gazprom-era histories), so low. Needs a primary (Kubangazprom history / Transgaz Moscow) to settle.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Newest dated evidence: Transgaz Moscow Voronezh LPUMG (Wayback 2024-11-15) and Elets LPUMG (2024-12-12) list Краснодарский Край — Серпухов I and II нитка as operated; one operator origin. No outage/diagnostics item found.

summary: Krasnodar-Serpukhov II: Diameter 820 and Length UNRESOLVED; Start proposed 1965; confirm operating.
